name: m5-zd-typednil-k4-wa
description: Wall-clock and allocation profile (async-profiler, no kperf) of 4 concurrent compiles of Pekko 1.7.1's `stream` with typed-`Nil` templates (labs/zinc/typed-nil.patch) at the Scala tip: the same workload as `m5-zd-typednil-k4`, which has the cycles and instructions profile. Shows waiting (GC pauses, locks, the copies' idle time) as well as running, and who allocates.

variantDescriptions.tip-k4: Zinc 1.12.1, Scala at the tip (6101d22); 4 concurrent compiles
